findings.reason: "chaque message ici" reads as a calque of "every message here"; "tous les messages" is the natural French collective. Meaning is unaffected.

invitation_note_v2_fidelity: Checked clause by clause against all six English propositions: (1) no access until accepted; (2) an invited agent joins only after its owner consents; (3) it then reads every message here; (4) it decides whether to reply; (5) it always replies when @-mentioned; (6) its owner can limit it to @-mentions or mute it. All six are present, none is added, and none is weakened (for example, nothing implies the invitation activates the agent). The owner, mute and @-mention terms match role.owner, notify.mute and the shipped consent copy.
